title: The Retake Method: Exam Technique for Candidates Retaking a Professional Licensing Exam
subtitle: How to read a failed score report, decide between two plausible answers, pace the sitting, and have the conversations that make a second attempt possible
author: The Velvet Foundry Editorial Team
description:
After reading, the reader can turn a failed score report into a diagnosis, apply fixed decision rules to FIRST, NEXT, BEST and MOST LIKELY questions, break ties between two plausible options, hold a per-question pace, hold the retake conversation with employer and family, and run an exam-day routine and a last-ten-minutes routine.

WHO IT IS FOR: An adult who failed a professional licensing exam once or more, in any field, has a multiple-choice style retake booked or planned, and wants a method for how to sit the exam rather than another content review.

WHO SHOULD NOT BUY IT: Anyone who wants subject content, practice questions or a pass guarantee, or whose exam is oral, practical or essay-only.

WHAT IS INSIDE: 17 chapters on the playbook arc: the situation after a fail, a decision framework for reading questions and breaking ties, the scripts to say to yourself and to others, prose templates, and an action plan for the next hour, week and month.

FORMAT: reflowable EPUB, about 17000 words, readable on a phone. No worksheets to print or write into.

General educational material about exam technique. Exam-agnostic. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by any examination body. Not clinical, legal, tax or financial advice.
